metaTitle: Valorant Rank Command for Twitch | ItsBagelBot
metaDesc: Show Valorant rank and RR with !valrank in Twitch chat. Link your Riot ID, check recent matches with !valmatches, and view leaderboards or the global shop.
title: Your Valorant rank in Twitch chat.
lead: Viewers type !valrank to see your rank and RR, or !valmatches for recent ranked games. Enable the free module and link your Riot ID to get started.
howTitle: Link your Riot ID and try !valrank.
step1Desc: Switch on Valorant Stats in the dashboard and enter your Riot ID as Name#Tag. This is the player the bot looks up when a command has no player name.
step2Desc: Anyone can type !valrank in chat. The bot replies with your rank, RR, last RR change and peak rank.
step3Desc: Each command has its own switch and message template in the dashboard. Keep the stats you want chat to see.
limitsNote: The module is off by default. Each command has a 10 second cooldown.
faqQ1: How do I show my Valorant rank in Twitch chat?
faqA1: Enable Valorant Stats in the ItsBagelBot dashboard and enter your Riot ID as Name#Tag. Viewers can then type !valrank to see your current rank and RR.
faqQ2: Do I need to install anything on my gaming PC?
faqA2: The command runs through ItsBagelBot and posts the reply in Twitch chat. You can use it without installing an app or adding an overlay.
faqA3: Yes. Valorant Stats is included in the free plan.
faqQ4: Can I keep chat from spamming it?
faqA4: Each command has a 10 second cooldown. You can also switch individual commands off in the dashboard.
legal: ItsBagelBot is not affiliated with or endorsed by Riot Games.
tblNote: Each command has its own on/off switch and message template in the dashboard.
prereq1: Enable Valorant Stats in the dashboard. The module is off by default.
prereq2: A Riot ID in Name#Tag form for the default player.
item1Desc: Enter Name#Tag as the default player. Include the tag so the bot can find the right account.
item2Desc: By default, viewers can look up another player with !val Frosty#EUW1. You can restrict lookups to your linked account.
item3Desc: Use na, eu, ap, kr, br or latam. Leave it blank to let the bot detect the account’s region.
item4Desc: PC and console have separate ranks and leaderboards. PC is the default; try !val lb console ap for a console leaderboard.
item5Desc: !val shop shows today's global skin rotation, with VP prices and the time until reset.
item6Desc: Each command has a 10 second cooldown.
